Tdoc Quota: Maximum allowed number of Tdocs for any company. This is set by the RAN3 Chairman for submission towards an Agenda Item or Sub-Agenda Item (including all its sub-sections). It will be indicated in the Chairman's Notes in the heading of each Agenda Item or Sub-Agenda Item. Meeting the Tdoc quota does not guarantee that the Tdocs will be treated. (This limit is to be taken very seriously. The aim is to limit the available "ammunition", in order for companies to prioritize their "targets" and to make the meeting more efficient.) Response papers count toward the Tdoc quota. Tdoc Quota: Maximum allowed number of Tdocs for any company. This is set by the RAN3 Chairman for submission towards an Agenda Item or Sub-Agenda Item. It is indicated in the Chairman's Notes in the heading of each Agenda Item or Sub-Agenda Item. The quota indicated in an Agenda Item applies to the sum of the Tdocs submitted to all its sub-Agenda Items unless otherwise specified; this is to allow the freedom to prioritize which sub-topics to contribute to. Meeting the Tdoc quota does not guarantee that the Tdocs will be treated. If a sourcing company exceeds its quota for an AI, none of its contributions for that AI will be treated.
